name: CubeSat Mission VR
summary:
CubeSat Mission VR

Build. Test. Launch. Explore Space.

Become a Space Systems Engineer and experience the complete CubeSat mission in immersive Virtual Reality.

Explore realistic 3D CubeSat components, learn how each subsystem works, test mission-critical hardware, assemble a fully functional satellite, validate spacecraft readiness, and launch your CubeSat into Earth orbit.
